summary: Tested 4 new features: Clients marquee strip, Insights blog (backend seed + GET/POST), email non-blocking behavior when RESEND_API_KEY empty, and OG cover image. All 20 backend pytest tests pass (100%). All frontend acceptance checks pass (clients-strip with label + 20 tiles incl. automerid & kestrel-engineering, insights-section with heading 'Field notes from the trenches.' + exactly 6 insight cards + Read note link + date/category/read_minutes, Navbar nav-link-insights => #insights, OG/twitter meta point to hiqanalytix.com/og-cover.png, JSON-LD ProfessionalService present). /og-cover.png returns 200 image/png > 30KB.

issues: Frontend hard-caps display to 6 cards. If a new insight is POSTed via API, it replaces the oldest seeded card (e.g., HIPAA-aware analytics dropped). Consider paginating or bumping the limit if user posts are expected to persist alongside seeds.

critical_code_review_comments: _notify/_send_email_sync should already handle missing RESEND_API_KEY as a no-op — verified via /api/health email_configured=false and contact/roi still returning 201.
Insights display cap of 6 on the frontend may hide seed content once user posts land — consider a Load More or increasing the cap.
Test data prefix TEST_ is respected; agent cleaned up TEST_ inserts in insights, contacts, roi collections after run.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds >=6 insight posts on startup via _ensure_insights_seed(). Verified 6 categories: Power BI, Automation, Automotive, Financial, Energy, Health.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 20 pytest cases cover health(email_configured=false), insights GET (>=6, sorted desc, no _id), insights POST valid+3 invalid, contact regression (no email configured), roi regression, and og-cover.png (>30KB, image/png). Frontend playwright validated clients-strip label + 20 tiles, insights-section heading + exactly 6 cards + Read note link, Navbar nav-link-insights, and OG/twitter meta + JSON-LD ProfessionalService. TEST_ data cleaned from DB post-run.
